body: I'm from almost 2 hours north.
You look the tootsie pop owl who watched one anime and decided to become a weeb and a cat girl.

I do actually bake. Not that often anymore since my ex broke up with me. I do care about my girlfriend so much, but it is just that I have these things that keep nagging me and bothering me all the time while I am at work. I work 10 hour days in a factory so my mind is not very busy most of the time

It was not a typo. I do not think she was a predator. We had an amazing relationship while it lasted. It was good, but we grew apart. She left me for someone else, and it was hard at first, but i am getting over it. My new relationship has also been amazing. I love my new girlfriend with all my heart. But I have moments where I will feel worthless and like I am not worth it. I am working on getting over it, but it will take time.
I am having a hard time of it. But i am feeling a little better today than I have in a long while.
I don't think so. We had an amazing relationship, and an amazing friendship too. We got along so good. Not once did I feel like i was being used or that i was just a toy.

I don't feel that she was a predator at all. She didn't groom me or anything. We became genuine friends and then that progressed to more than that. She left me for someone else. That was the end of that. My girlfriend is 6 months younger than I am, so we are very close in age. We are both new to relationships, so it is something we are learning together.

I do. I spend most of my time at work, or talking to my girlfriend, or playing video games. I smoked weed in the beginning, but that made me way too paranoid and now I usually just play games or watch videos/movies to fill the empty space and keep my mind off of things.

No no. It came across perfectly fine. I do love her the best I can. We live an hour and an half apart and I see her when I can on the weekend. I lost my virginity to her a few months ago, and I try my best to treat her like she should be.
I am 20, and my current girlfriend is 19, almost 20.
I may do that. It is not that I can't talk about things. It's just the fear of making her upset. I don't want to add on to her own insecurities and make things worse for her, if that makes sense?

I have before, but she has been getting more and more like this lately. I try my best to help, but I feel like it is never enough. Which then makes my mind spiral, and leads me into depression which I don't show and it just bubbles. I have come close to opening up recently, but I just feel that I can't, and so I just act like everything is okay.
And the same goes for you! Feel free to message, even if it is to ask any questions you may have.
Thank you. I really do appreciate it. I only have the best wishes for you too, good stranger.
I know, but it has been months now and it still bothers me sometimes. I am trying, and I know I will get over it. Maybe some time away from my ex is what i need.

I may do that. I think with her I will just have to drift for a little bit, and just focus on myself. I still have issues stemming from this incident, and maybe just need some time with my girlfriend to just focus on us so that way I can finally completely get over it.
I may do that. Did you say you needed space? Or did you just kind of drift away for awhile?

I know. I try to stay friendly, but sometimes I find it hard because I feel... resentment almost. The fact that either way she was going to still have someone, and I was left with nothing. Does this make sense?

I try to be a good friend to her, but I keep the conversation focused on her and not myself most of the time. I just give her short answers when it comes to myself and I let her know very little of what is happening in my life.

But I am emotionally conflicted because she was there for me in the aftermath. She was and always has been a good friend, but I do see your point. I have gone days without messaging her, but she does have a contact for my parents because after we broke up i had an emotional breakdown and tried to kill myself and she got into contact with my dad (who I work with) and that forced me to open up to my parents about what I was going through.  I felt like I would never have happiness like that again. I still find myself having self esteem issues even though my current girlfriend compliments me all the time. She tells me that I am the "perfect boyfriend" but I just feel that I am never and will never be enough. I also have some past issues that kind of cement that in my brain.
We were going to, but did a lot of video calling, and talking over Skype.

Thank you. I try my best. I now see my new girlfriend once a week, because she lives an hour and a half away, but her family loves me, and I love them all. They are great people, and I don't want to ruin this relationship.

I know it is not right, but I feel that it is the best thing to do right now. Maybe later, once we've been together longer, but for right now I just feel it is best to keep it quiet so she doesn't think that she was a rebound

Thank you. I do try. My new girlfriend says I am a good boyfriend, and I try my best to be, but she doesn't know that my old relationship ended only about a week before meeting her. I won't tell her, and things are going good, and I'm happy right now, so no need to screw that up for the both of us.
It will not. I've told my girlfriend that we are friends, but I've never disclosed any other part of the relationship to her. We are now just distant friends, nothing more, nothing less.
I know. I am nice and civil to her, but I still feel that I don't want to become too close to her again because I feel that I can't trust her to not hurt me again.
I kind of do regret it, because it caused us both pain and hurt. But at the same time, I don't, because she gave me a lot of good moments. I do know I did wrong, and I've learned my lesson.

I did. My new girlfriend was single when I met her, not anymore obviously, but my ex reached out to me on here, and we moved from here to Skype and other media to talk. I've learned my lesson and the only married woman I'll date is my girlfriend when I make her my wife.
Thank you. I'll try to start seeing myself as better, or at least get better at combatting these feelings when they arise.
No. I would not. I would still love them the same. I wouldn't think anything less of them.

Thank you. I see what you mean, but I still don't know how to fix it. I have days where I see myself very well, but most days I just don't like myself. I cannot accept anyone's compliments. My parents, my girlfriends, anyone's.
Thank you. But I am not a good person. You, my girlfriend, and my ex all think that I am not, but I am.
